note: SKR Eyes 1.3 promo. Sixty seconds, vertical, English. Nothing here claims the app stakes: 1.3 only reads the chain. The one line about staking names where it went and does not apologise.

lines.l1: SKR Eyes, version one point three. The SKR vault, alive in your hand.
lines.l2: Every phone falling in is a finalized stake, with the name of the person who made it.
lines.l3: Four point nine eight billion SKR held, the day drawn hour by hour, and the exits cooling above the pile.
lines.l4: Flow is every move as it lands, by kind and by size, with the day's biggest pinned on top.
lines.l5: Top is everybody who stakes, in order. The treasury wallets are set aside, so number one is a person.
lines.l6: And the radar puts all forty six thousand on one dial, your own phone gold among them.
lines.l7: Your card: your days in stake, your weight in the vault, and what your position has earned.
lines.l8: Free, and open source. A quiet place to thank the developer, and nothing at all behind it.
lines.l9: One change to name. Staking has been removed from the app: SKR Eyes only watches the chain now. You stake with your Solana Mobile wallet.
lines.l10: SKR Eyes. By Alex Kosa. On the Solana dApp Store.
